draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.81, the 226th-best grade among 257 2024 draftees and 32nd of 35 at WR. He went 187th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (226th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 670 receiving yards in 2023, 27th of 35 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 3 pro, currently with the Carolina Panthers (practice squad). 15 career games and 2 starts over 2 completed seasons. Still developing: 1 AV in 2025. Weak spots: approximate value 1 (18th percentile), team target share 2.7% (21st percentile). Played 7 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-2 wide receiver who played: 94 receiving yards against a median of 290, below the norm.
